Resolves Dickinson's separate Question(2), OWR-15957-003 (30003650): in every order n>=1 the maximal finite CP-plus-rank equals the maximal CP-rank p_n, including singular matrices and attainment. The same rank-preserving constructions directly give equality of maxima in each exact ordinary-rank stratum. The general maximum pointwise gap in Question(1) and an explicit numeric formula for all p_n remain unresolved. The positive Perron lift is credited to Bomze, Dickinson and Still. Existing DOI and all three published files verified; the closed18-member source archive contains complete proofs and exact rational regression checks, reproduced in three Python modes. These finite checks are supplementary, not minimal-factor certification or formal verification. No new publication or claim of chronological firstness.
